decisions.reason: Locates the exact disabled expression in plugin-dock-chips.js, shows busy is AttachButton's useState local and unbound in AttachmentChips, and explains empty occurrences return null before the map while a present chip in plain phase makes the guard false, evaluating busy and throwing ReferenceError.

Explains the slot error boundary unmounts the entire dock entry on the render throw rather than just the remove button, the attach-button slot survives with its own boundary, and the error appears only in the browser console with no user-facing banner.

Uses the shipped v0.2.10 expression to place busy in the baseline, proposes both a hunk-level rollback/re-add bisect and a minimal data-present plain-phase mount, and grounds the diff-vs-baseline disabled-line inconsistency plus the imageItem-before-record/status scoping defect without forcing the diff as harmless or overclaiming historical first-exercise timing.

Removes the dangling busy reference while preserving the phase guard (offering a properly-owned-state alternative), scopes the hover lookup inside the map callback where record/status are defined, and adds record?.items ?? [] defensive reads plus optional-chained closest with a safe element check, explaining why these are cheap insurance in slot components.

Proposes a plain-phase render smoke with one occurrence asserting the chip and remove button render with no error-boundary capture, explains the empty state returns null before the throwing line and that node --check only parses without resolving identifiers, and includes the data-present smoke as the mandatory pre-ship gate.
